items.title: SAP weighs cutting at least 10,000 jobs in AI restructuring, Bloomberg says
items.summary: SAP is preparing to cut at least 10,000 jobs as it reshapes its software business around AI, Christina Kyriasoglou reported for Bloomberg on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter. That would be at least 9% of the German company’s workforce. SAP employs more than 110,000 people worldwide.
